text:
This looks like June 2013, right after the taper tantrum began.

- Gold fell 12.9% in one month and 23% over three months, which matches the April–June 2013 crash.
- The 10-year yield was 2.49%, up 0.62 over three months. It was about 2.5% at the end of June 2013.
- Unemployment was 7.6%, matching May 2013 (7.5%) and June 2013 (7.6%), and the fed funds rate was about 0.09%.
- Headline CPI at 1.39% year over year and core CPI at 1.68% fit May 2013 (headline 1.4%, core 1.7%).
- US large-cap equity fell 2.8% in the month, consistent with June 2013 (S&P about -1.5%, total return roughly -1.5%). Emerging-market equity fell 7.0% in the month, which also fits June 2013.

Because the unemployment rate for June was published in early July, the latest values here probably reflect data known at the end of June, so the snapshot is June 2013.
